steps.title: Connection settings
steps.instructions: Configure a token from your own Netatmo developer application with read_magellan and write_magellan scopes. Pair Legrand devices through Home + Control and its gateway. This token-only adapter cannot verify a stable account ID. Once devices are registered, replacing a token requires a new integration and selecting its devices again.
